newsitem.title: MEXICO: Two die, several escape in Mexico City jailbreak.
newsitem.headline: Two die, several escape in Mexico City jailbreak.

text.p: Two prisoners died in a bloody jailbreak from a Mexico City prison late on Sunday and possibly as many six inmates were still at large, according to radio and television reports.
Prison director Juan Jesus Mora told a television news programme by telephone that three prisoners had been also wounded in a gun battle at the Reclusorio del Oriente prison.
During the escape, prisoners overpowered unarmed janitors during a visiting period. The armed prisoners then made for the prison's main front door.
Television reports showed the bodies of the two prisoners shot during the escape.
The prison director said control had been restored at the prison. "We have absolute control of the institution," Jesus Mora told TV Azteca.
Among the wounded was a woman prisoner, he said.
Radio reports said six prisoners had escaped from the prison, but other reports placed the number of prisoners still at large at three.
